description: This file handles the display and processing of popup windows for various modules in a CRM system, including listing records, handling search and filters, and rendering the popup interface using Smarty templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering the popup interface.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab for the current module.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input parameters to prevent security issues.

methods.name: LoggerManager::getLogger
methods.description: Gets a logger instance for logging purposes.

methods.name: AlphabeticalSearch
methods.description: Performs an alphabetical search for records in a module.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Retrieves translated string for a given label.

methods.name: getRelCheckquery
methods.description: Generates a query to check related records.

methods.name: getPopupCheckquery
methods.description: Generates a query for popup record checks.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Builds the main list query for records.

methods.name: fetchCurrency
methods.description: Fetches the default currency for a user.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Retrieves the product name given a product ID.

methods.name: getSearchListHeaderValues
methods.description: Gets header values for list view search.

methods.name: getWhereCondition
methods.description: Constructs the WHERE condition for list queries.

methods.name: getSearchListViewHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the list view header for search results.

methods.name: getSearchListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves list view entries for search results.

methods.name: getTableHeaderSimpleNavigation
methods.description: Generates navigation controls for list views.

methods.name: vtlib_setup_modulevars
methods.description: Initializes module variables for popup views.

methods.name: getMailFields
methods.description: Retrieves mail-related fields for a module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Gets the tab ID for a module.
